title: In the functional sense there is something it is like to be a zombie

statements.text: Zombies lack only phenomenal consciousness properly so called, and in that technical sense humans are zombies. But zombies have introspective mechanisms functionally identical to human ones, so in the functional sense there is something it is like to be one. Imagining zombies as different from humans is imagining creatures with different introspective capacities.

sources.quote: there is something it is like to be a zombie, since zombies have introspective mechanisms functionally identical to our own
